feasibility: Achievable only with aggressive multi-epoch reuse + very large synthetic generation + PDF/OCR/ASR pipelines that don't exist off-the-shelf for Indic. BharatGen claims to be here [VENDOR CLAIM] but the corpus is not redistributable.
requirement: §16.2 'Stretch, phase 2': OCR of India's print archive at scale (an Indic-script OCR model), a BharatGen/Bharat Data Sagar data agreement, 2 epochs on the highest-quality 30% of the mix, and materially expanded synthetic generation.
